invariants.rule: The name, trimmed of Unicode whitespace and NFC-normalised, is 1 to 100 Unicode scalar values.
The class, trimmed of Unicode whitespace and NFC-normalised, is 1 to 50 Unicode scalar values of free text.
The level is a JSON integer literal from 1 to 20 inclusive; strings, decimals and anything else are refused.
No two active PCs of one campaign share a name, compared lowercased after trimming and NFC; archived PCs and other campaigns do not count.
No command but an archive writes an archived or unknown PC.
